title: Admiral Sir William Andrewes KBE CBE CB DSO
partOf: TNA Discovery › Imperial War Museum (IWM) Department of Documents

summary: Microfilm copy of a ts diary for January 1925 - February 1927 covering his troopship voyages to and from the Far East and his appointment as the torpedo officer of the submarine depot ship HMS AMBROSE on the China Station and giving a straightforward account of his daily routine; a ts diary for January - May 1930 kept during his appointment as the torpedo officer of the battleship HMS WARSPITE, the flagship of the Mediterranean Fleet, with some interesting references to tactical exercises and other naval matters; a ts account (6pp), dated April 1932 and written during his service in the cruise
